scope: Research-only structural contract for the bounded Filter type-origin analyzer. This contract does not enable the detector in the public Runner.

identity_trust_roots.profile_selection: exact full commit must select one frozen source profile; unknown commits are blocked. The model records the matching tree OID as review provenance, while ScanRequest currently carries and the adapter enforces commit plus every declared source blob; it does not independently compare a request tree OID.
identity_trust_roots.target_source_identity: Recompute Git blob ID from supplied UTF-8 bytes and compare both the pinned model blob and the shared source_blob_oid fact before analysis.
identity_trust_roots.creator_source_identity: Recompute Git blob ID from supplied UTF-8 bytes and compare both the pinned model blob and the shared source_blob_oid fact before analysis.
identity_trust_roots.dependencies: Every pinned C++ source dependency is present, language-tagged cpp, and byte-checked against the model blob. GN/GNI dependencies are represented only as build_config_blob_oid facts and are never forged into C++ SourceUnit values.

semantic_contract.owner_and_type_resolution: Tree-sitter lexical namespace/class owner and parameter spelling are only local structural evidence. Macro expansion, C++ overload resolution, inheritance, implicit conversions, and build-selected declarations are unknown unless separately proven by a compiler profile.

ast_and_generated_graph_subset.parser: Tree-sitter C++ structural parser; exact tree-sitter 0.26.0, tree-sitter-cpp 0.23.4 and grammar ABI 14 are model-bound; a mismatch fails before AST analysis.
ast_and_generated_graph_subset.production_precondition: SourceUnit.parse_status == complete, parser reports no error nodes, shared AST eligibility fact exists, exact source bindings pass, and model/build profile is resolved.
ast_and_generated_graph_subset.research_partial_precondition: Explicit research_partial entry point only; source bytes and Git blob must still match, the selected function itself must parse and resolve uniquely, and all partial-contamination limitations must remain attached.
supported_statement_forms: declaration without lambda or writable alias
control_requirements: label identity resolves to a local Label binding
control arity matches the modeled operation
cyclic allocation sites cannot reuse one static creation identity
ast_and_generated_graph_subset.symbol_policy: Only explicit operation/arity sets in RuntimeTypeModel are summarized. Same spelling without the exact modeled receiver, scope, arity, owner, and dependency evidence is unknown or not applicable.
ast_and_generated_graph_subset.effect_policy: Unknown calls invalidate sampled runtime type/HClass facts and exception checks; unsupported aliasing, nested side effects, writes, or generated control produce unknown/partial, never safe.
ast_and_generated_graph_subset.budget_policy: Byte, instruction, scope-depth, state, step, and wall-time exhaustion cannot yield a complete safe result. Incomplete functions are discarded while earlier observations remain scoped and the file remains partial.

result_semantics.candidate: A bounded symbolic path reports a differing modeled type-token origin. This is a source-level candidate, not proof of a runtime type mismatch or security impact.
result_semantics.matched: A bounded modeled path proves origin/equality for that path only; this is not a component-level safe verdict.
result_semantics.unknown: The target or relevant effect/type/edge cannot be resolved under the declared subset.
result_semantics.partial: Some source was inspected but parse, dependency, effect, build, or budget obligations remain unresolved; findings retain partial coverage.

known_unresolved_contract_items: Historical parent/fix translation units remain parser-partial and lack matching compiler preprocessing/build profiles.
The current a65 product Clang AST/build evidence does not transfer to either historical source profile.
No matching product image or Ark VM execution establishes actual species behavior, entry/attacker control, or security impact.

The independent ETS Frontend blind applicability review is labelled for all 21/21 samples (21.2% of complete translation units and 0.92% of complete-file function definitions); three labels are unknown, and semantic recall/component-wide accuracy remain unmeasured.
The native parser binary digest is not separately recorded; package versions and grammar ABI are frozen.
